Watch out for his deadly laser attacks!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[D00M's Revenge]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''P3NGU''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had a very high amount of health compared to all other enemies in the event except [[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky D00M]], and a slightly slow speed. It spawns in the sky, falling down onto one of the plots, during which it was a [[Flying]] enemy, which meant towers needed flying detection to attack it. When it got re-added in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it was changed so that it also spawns in with the [[Stun Immunity]]. It lost its attributes after it landed. Unlike most other enemies in [[D00M's Revenge]], it did not head to the exit, but instead walked on the plots. Beyond wave 20, its health would increase over time. '''P3NGU''' had one ability, ''Beak-A-Beam''. The ability makes it scream and fire a red laser from its beak at towers, which stuns any towers hit. Uniquely, most of the time, '''P3NGU''' could not decrease your base health. Rather, it stunned towers so that other enemies would have an easier time getting to the exit. This was not the case if it spawned on Wave ???, where it would act like any other enemy and head directly to the exit. Three '''P3NGUs''' were spawned by [[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky D00M]] after it initiated its ''Rage Mode'' ability. ==Appearance== '''P3NGU''' is a giant penguin covered in metal armor. Its torso and wings are black, and the front of its torso was white. Its legs, feet, lower torso, chest, face, upper arms, head and beak were covered in grey metal armor, which in turn have multiple screws and bolts on them. It also has rocket boosters built into its feet. In its beak, there is a laser that can fire a red laser which stuns towers. Its eyes and the inside of its beak are neon orange. When spawning, it slowly descends from the sky, with rocket boosters at its feet slowing its descent. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *While '''P3NGU''' cannot damage your base health, it can stun your towers, allowing other enemies to slip past and enter the exit. **This, however, is not the case if it spawns on wave ???. **Because of this, the [[Medic]] is recommended to cleanse stunned towers. ***Due to how often '''P3NGU''' uses its ''Beak-A-Beam'' ability, and that later on multiple '''P3NGUs''' spawn, you may need multiple [[Medic]]s. One sole [[Medic]] may not be enough as ''Beak-A-Beam'' can be performed more often than a single [[Medic]]'s ability. *High range towers, such as a Level 3 [[Ranger]], can be used to deal with '''P3NGU''', as it can keep '''P3NGU''' in its range for longer. **You should set your [[Ranger]]s to ''Strongest'' so that they do not attack weaker enemies. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] are recommended against this. **You can also use the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost their firerate and range respectively. *The [[Pursuit]] can be useful against this, as it cannot be stunned by '''P3NGU's''' ''Beak-A-Beam'' ability. **Do note that the [[Pursuit]] might be locked onto other enemies when '''P3NGU''' appears. *While '''P3NGU''' can be slowed down by slowing towers, such as the [[Sledger]], [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]], since it cannot reach the center (outside of wave ???) and that freezing or stunning it cannot stall its ''Beak-A-Beam'' ability, doing this has no practical use. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDRP3NGU.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png|'''P3NGU''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Penguin.png|'''P3NGU''' on a promotional image. DuckHuntPI.png|'''P3NGU''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''P3NGU''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyP3NGUIconIG.png|'''P3NGU''' on its [[Index]] icon. DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''P3NGU''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *'''P3NGU''' is based on the [[w:c:r2da:P3NG-W1N|P3NG-W1N]] from ''R2DA''. **Its ''Beak-A-Beam'' ability is also similar to [[w:c:r2da:P3NG-W1N|P3NG-W1N]]'s ''Beak Beam''. *The name ''P3NGU'' is similar to the TV show name [[wp:en:Pingu|Pingu]], originally broadcast for Swiss television, then later British television. *When '''P3NGU''' was first shown on [https://x.com/paradoxum_games/status/1512822646441922566 Paradoxum Games X], it was called ''P3NGWIN'' instead of ''P3NGU''. *If you are on wave ??? for about half an hour, the game will begin to only spawn '''P3NGUs'''. Rather than them landing on the plots and walking on them, they will act like every other enemy, spawning in the outer area and heading to the exit. You are guaranteed to lose when this happens due to their high health and numbers, so it is pointless to try to defend. **This is the only time where '''P3NGU''' can damage the base. *Its ''Beak-A-Beam'' ability's hitbox is slightly shorter than what the laser displays. *Sometimes when '''P3NGU''' spawned, it could not be attacked by any tower until it landed, even if they had flying detection. Additionally, '''P3NGU''' at times could spawn without [[Flying]], only gaining it shortly after spawning, which allowed towers without flying detection to attack it. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''P3NGU''' added. *'''21 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.3]] **{{Bug}} '''P3NGU''' never stops firing its beam when the ''Beak-A-Beam'' ability is used. *'''21 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.3]]a **{{Bugfix}} '''P3NGU''' no longer uses its ''Beak-A-Beam'' ability forever. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''P3NGU''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''P3NGU''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[P3NGU (Ducky Revenge)|P3NGU]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. **Now spawns with the [[Stun Immunity]], which is lost upon landing. **{{Bug}} '''P3NGU''' has a broken icon in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|[[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]]|Wave 9|P3NGU|Wave 10|[[Operator Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Operator Ducky]]|Wave 11}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:P3NGU}}
